subject: MAP: Security acceptance lane + data-retention annex for HalcyonBank evaluation
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Rachel Porter <rachel.porter@halcyonbank.com>
Cc: Aaron Tse <aaron.tse@halcyonbank.com>, procurement@halcyonbank.com
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: MAP: Security acceptance lane + data-retention annex for HalcyonBank evaluation

Hi Rachel —

Thanks for the time yesterday. Attached is a draft Mutual Action Plan (MAP) focused on the security/compliance lane we discussed, plus a short SOC 2 evidence index and an initial set of DPA redlines. Quick summary:

- Goal: get HalcyonBank to a formal acceptance decision for Redwood inference in a 6–8 week runway.
- Key gates: SOC 2 report review, SIG/CAIQ responses, executed DPA with explicit retention annex (EU/US residency options), and evidence staging for archive/escrow.
- Proposed near-term milestones (from MAP spreadsheet):
  1) Evidence intake worksheet completed by Halcyon (Week 1)
  2) SOC 2 readout + clarifications (Week 2)
  3) DPA redlines and retention annex confirmed (Week 3)
  4) Staging environment security test (Week 4)
  5) Final acceptance window (Week 6–8)

Attachments: MAP_Halcyon_v1.2.xlsx (MAP with owners/dates), SOC2-evidence-index.pdf (index of artifacts we can deliver), DPA-redlines-proposed.docx (our recommended carveouts and residency language).

Immediate asks for Halcyon: please confirm the primary evidence owner (name & email) and whether the retention annex should target US-only, EU-only, or hybrid residency. That will determine the acceptance path and whether we need an on-prem or VPC private deployment in the MAP.

Happy to jump on a short 30-minute cadence call this week to walk through the MAP and assign owners. Suggested times: Wed 11–12 PT or Thu 2–4 PT.

Thanks,
Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Sr. Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
(h) +1 415-555-0149

Attachments: MAP_Halcyon_v1.2.xlsx (spreadsheet), SOC2-evidence-index.pdf (pdf), DPA-redlines-proposed.docx (docx)

From: Rachel Porter <rachel.porter@halcyonbank.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: Aaron Tse <aaron.tse@halcyonbank.com>, Halcyon Bank Procurement <procurement@halcyonbank.com>
Date: Wed, 16 Jun 2027 08:11:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP: Security acceptance lane + data-retention annex for HalcyonBank evaluation

Hi Hannah —

Thanks for the materials, and for the clear breakdown. A few clarifying items from our side before we can assign owners internally:

1) Data residency: our legal & risk teams will require either EU-only or strict dual-region with contractual residency guarantees for the EU dataset. Can you confirm whether Redwood offers EU region hosting for the production model (not just staging)? If there are any supply-chain or third-party dependencies that live outside the chosen region we need that detail.

2) SOC 2 evidence: the PDF is helpful — can you provide a mapping to our SIG/CAIQ questions? We have a small internal questionnaire that references specific CAIQ sections; if you can highlight the matching evidence IDs in the index, that will speed review.

3) DPA redlines: procurement will review, but open question: do you accept a standard bank addendum around deletion on request + certification of destruction? We may also ask for a 30-day return window for ephemeral logs.

We can do the Wed 11 PT call — Rachel, Aaron, and I will join.

Regards,
Rachel Porter
Sr. Manager, Vendor Risk — Halcyon Bank

Hannah

Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 16:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: MAP: Security acceptance lane + data-retention annex for HalcyonBank evaluation

All — quick update and proposed owner-level plan.

1) EU hosting: confirmed we can offer EU region for production (Redwood Private via customer VPC or our EU-hosted Dedicated pool). Soojin: please list the exact KMS, metrics, and logging endpoints that will be in the EU vs. those that may touch a global control plane. I expect this will satisfy Halcyon’s supply-chain ask if called out in the MAP.

2) SIG/CAIQ mapping: I started a mapping doc and linked it to the MAP folder (see Drive link in metadata). I will populate CAIQ IDs against the SOC2-evidence-index by EOD Tue. That will include clear artifact references and short notes for any partial controls.

3) DPA redlines: Kim, I reviewed the proposed deletion + certification language. We can accept the deletion on request with certification of destruction for customer data. Ephemeral logs request (30-day return window) — recommend we offer a 30-day hold for ephemeral logs but keep audit trail metadata for 180 days; we should propose that compromise in our DPA redline. If legal signs off, I’ll incorporate and push a DocuSign envelope.

Proposed timeline to reflect in the MAP (updated):
- Tue (6/22): CAIQ mapping complete and uploaded
- Wed (6/23): Joint MAP walk-through call (you already scheduled Wed 11 PT)
- Fri (6/25): DPA redlines updated and ready for procurement review
- Mon (6/28): Evidence intake complete (Halcyon owners to confirm)
- By Fri (7/02): Security staging test and short findings report

I’ll prepare the DocuSign envelope once Kim confirms the final DPA compromise language.

Thanks,
Jonas
Director, Security & Compliance — Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: DPA-redlines-proposed.docx (will be updated), CAIQ-mapping-draft.xlsx (in Drive)
